senses.definition: make or shape as with an axe
examples: hew out a path in the rock

senses.definition: strike with an axe; cut down, strike
make or shape as with an axe
examples: hew out a path in the rock

senses.definition: cut or shaped with hard blows of a heavy cutting instrument like an ax or chisel
examples: a house built of hewn logs
a path hewn through the underbrush
